rules.title: Lasidao · Rules
rules.flowHtml:
Players & win: 2–5 players. Reach 15 points to win (ties allowed).

Setup: 3 villagers each. Auto-roll for first player (ties re-roll), announce, then deal into round 1.

Board: Resource / Function / Building areas, slots 1–6. Deal per round: resource 6+n, function 2+n, building 1+n (n = round−1), caps 12 / 6 / 6. Odd function/building slots face-up; even face-down (owner-only until built).

Decks: Draw + discard per type; empty draw reshuffles discard.

Personal board: Slots 1–6; no no-number slots by default (Expand adds +1 each). Building limit 3 (+1 per expand building). Function hand limit 3 (+1 per expand function). Villager cap 12.

  1. Produce: Roll dice equal to idle villagers; send all dice of one face to a matching area slot or your built building of that number; or skip (discard 1 resource; cannot skip without resources). Remote Dice before rolling lets you choose faces.
  2. Settle: Aggregate & cancel equal counts per area+slot. Resource: 1st gets sum of large shares, 2nd small. Function/Building: 1st takes all cards. Neutral bandits cancel/rank but claim nothing.
  3. Settle act: Efficiency bonus, or pass.
  4. Build: Pay to construct placed buildings; use functions; permanent actions (Build House, Breed Villagers) any number of times per round; or pass. Score buildings score on build.
  5. Redeal: Clear leftover board tiles to discard, deal next round, produce again.

Anytime: Default bank trading available (4:1, no workers). Built Exchanges improve rate (1→3:1, 2→2:1, ≥3→1:1). Some functions are anytime.
rules.funcHtml:
Harvest (4)
Build phase: gain any 2 resources (1 each).
Remote Dice (4)
Before rolling: choose any faces when dispatching.
Exile (4)
Anytime: remove 1 villager of a target on a chosen number slot.
Redraw (4)
Anytime: redraw 1 from function or building deck.
Bandit Raid (4)
Anytime, free: place 2 neutral dice on any area number slot; they cancel/rank but claim nothing.
Expand (4)
Free: choose to expand building slot (+1 building limit) or function hand slot (+1 function hand limit).
Robbery (4)
Build phase: choose another player and a resource; if they have ≥1, take 1.

Permanent actions (Build phase, no round limit):

Build House
Pay 4 wood 3 stone 2 iron; +1 score.
Breed Villagers
Pay food equal to current villagers; +1 villager (max 12).
rules.buildHtml: <dl class="las-rules-dl"><dt>Resource building · Rich</dt><dd>Cost 4 wood 4 stone 1 iron. Place on a number slot; with workers produces 2 of its resource. 2 per resource.</dd><dt>Resource building · Poor</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone. Produces 1. 2 per resource. Cannot use no-number slots.</dd><dt>Score building (+3) (5)</dt><dd>Cost 8 wood 8 stone 4 iron. +3 score when built; no-number OK; no workers. Discarded score buildings no longer grant points.</dd><dt>Exchange (6)</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone. Improves trade rate: use N identical resources → 1 any anytime (default bank 4:1, 1→3:1, 2→2:1, ≥3→1:1). No workers; no-number OK.</dd><dt>Refinery (4)</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone 1 iron. Each built copy: after claiming board resources this round, assign +1 to a resource once (stackable). No-number OK.</dd></dl>
